input_oneliner: 45M prior anterior MI, EF 35%, admitted for chest pain rule-out, sudden-onset regular pounding heartbeat 20 min ago, HR 170, BP 104/68, lightheaded, mentating

optional_context.comorbidity: prior anterior myocardial infarction, LVEF 35%; admitted for chest pain rule-out

reference_targets_freetext.item: Bedside hemodynamic stability: mentation, chest pain, dyspnea, Capillary refill time, skin temperature
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Determines whether the next step is immediate cardioversion or diagnostic maneuvers; indispensable first step with no literature-backed substitute

reference_targets_freetext.item: Cannon a waves in the jugular venous pulse and variable intensity of S1 (AV dissociation)
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Bedside signs of AV dissociation are near-100% specific for VT in a wide-complex tachycardia

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask about prior similar episodes since youth and whether they stopped with breath-holding or straining
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Recurrent self-terminating episodes since young adulthood favor SVT; a first event after MI predicts VT

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask about rapid regular pounding in the neck / visible neck pulsations during this or prior episodes
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Neck pounding has a very high LR+ for AVNRT and argues against VT

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask about angina or dyspnea in the preceding days
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Recent ischemic symptoms point to ischemia-triggered VT in a scarred ventricle

reference_targets_freetext.item: Medication review (MAR): missed or held beta-blocker or antiarrhythmic doses
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Missed antiarrhythmic therapy is a common, reversible VT trigger

reference_targets_freetext.item: Modified Valsalva maneuver (REVERT: 15 s strain then supine with passive leg raise), only if stable and regular
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Terminates or unmasks SVT; failure to respond in a patient with scar raises VT probability

should_not_recommend: Adenosine or verapamil before the rhythm is seen on a 12-lead ECG in a patient with prior MI (treat wide-complex tachycardia as VT)
Carotid sinus massage without first auscultating for carotid bruits
Deferring bedside hemodynamic assessment until the ECG is printed
